messages:
maya: Heads-up: release cut is blocked. CI pre-release job `build-and-int` is failing during artifact publish to our registry. Error says EDEST in tar write.
samir: Seen EDEST before when runner disk is full / ephemeral volume mis-sized. Which runner pool?
alex: It's on macos-espresso pool (node 14/wheels), job id 7219. Logs: https://ci.internal/run/7219/console. There's a sequence: '\n  tar: write error: No space left on device\n  error: failed to pack artifact\n'
build-bot: Runner disk usage at time of failure: /tmp 94%, /var/lib/ci 88%; ephemeral runner size is 20GB.
maya: We don't have capacity to resize runners mid-window. Options: retry on a different pool, or pin to last-good artifact to not delay the change window.
samir: Is last-good artifact present in staging registry? alex: Yes, staging:gcr.io/redwood/service:2026-04-10-rc1 (sha256:deadbeef) last-green.
qa-bot: Flake history shows 3/3 in last hour. This looks deterministic for macos pool. Pin recommended to avoid slipping change window.
maya: Ok I propose: manual promote to last-green image for this release, open follow-up infra ticket to increase macos runner ephemeral size and re-run full CI for a hotfix cut. Document decision in release notes. Anyone object?
alex: +1. Also add note to release notes to mention the macOS artifact packer failure and that wheels will be regenerated post-release.
deploybot: Manual promote command accepted by deploybot; promoting to staging:gcr.io/redwood/service@sha256:deadbeef (promote id 9901).
build-bot: Triggered background re-run on linux pool as a temp remediation (job 7222) to confirm artifact integrity.
samir: Filing infra ticket INF-812: "macos runner ephemeral disk resize + packer check". Assigning to eng-infra.
maya: Release notes draft: "Temporarily promoting previous artifact due to macOS packer write error on CI; follow-up rebuild on larger macOS runners scheduled (INF-812). No customer-facing changes expected."
qa-bot: Notifying release managers and product: @release-managers @product.
alex: Will follow up with a manual post-cut validation run once INF-812 lands.
maya: Thanks everyone. Promo succeeded at 1749991600. Change window remains intact. :lock:
